simple.meaning: Tabeel , the name of a Syrian and of a Persian

definitions.short: Tabeel , the name of a Syrian and of a Persian
definitions.full: H2870. tab 'el טָֽבְאֵל proper name, masculine (Aramaic; = God is good , see טוֺב ; according to Wkl (see below) God is wise , compare Aramaic , Ethiopic be wise ; Arabic act as physician , expert ) — Persian officer in Samaria Ezra 4:7 , ᵐ5 Ταβεηλ . טָֽבְאַ֑ל proper name, masculine (apparently pointed to mean good-for-nothing ( אַל as negative) see De Di Du Sta Gesch i. 590 , originally טָֽבְאֵל ; Ol § 91 d Kö ii, 537 and others think אַ֑ל - simply pausal form) — Aramean, whose son Pekah and Resin proposed to make king of Jerusalem in place of Ahaz; only בֶּןטָֽֿבְאַ֑ל Isa 7:6 (Wkl Alttest. Untersuch. 1892. 74 identification with Resin, comparing טַבְרִמֹּן father of Benhadad).
